fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Subject the question belongs to, as the student tagged it (free text; homework arrives for any subject, enrolled or not)

fields.label: Grade
fields.description: The student's grade at submission time, for the fulfilment side's context

fields.label: Question Text
fields.description: The homework question exactly as the student submitted it

fields.label: Attachment Refs
fields.description: Optional JSON list of attachment references (file URLs/ids) the student included with the question

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Submitted
In Review
Ready
Declined
Completed
fields.description: Send-and-wait lifecycle (product log #4/#42): Submitted -> In Review -> Ready (MCQ published) -> Completed (student attempted), or -> Declined (essay-type, not reducible to MCQ)

fields.label: MCQ JSON
fields.description: SERVER-SIDE ONLY guided check (product log #1): {question, options, correct_index, explanation}. correct_index/explanation must never reach a student before their attempt is recorded — student reads go through api.homework, which strips them until answer_homework_mcq

fields.label: Decline Reason
fields.description: Why this question was declined (essay/written-argument boundary in product log #1) — shown to the student

fields.label: Answered Index
fields.description: Index of the option the student picked; empty until they attempt

fields.label: Answer Outcome
fields.description: How the student's attempt landed; empty until they attempt
